title: Good value and chance to try new products
text: I wanted to try this beauty club to check out some of the newer products on the market. I was pleasantly surprised at the value of products that came in the boxes I have received. Two full size products and sample sizes in others. A good variety of beauty products. Somehow I must have two memberships for I received 2 January boxes. The February box, which is very nice, came just yesterday 2/13/20 and I didn't expect it to come so fast. I used Amazon's membership process and have read the boxes come sooner with this membership than directly from Allure. Do not know about that but I do know I have enjoyed the boxes I have received so far. So did my niece who received the other January box. I do recommend this membership.
label: positive
